scope: Actual local browser actions; SDK assertions and contract tests are separately identified.
curation: Selected timing, actions and limitations from the original local review record. Screenshots retained below; other original screenshots are omitted.

steps: Selected demo.test.near and used Deposit & Long NEAR in browser: 500 test USDC, 50x.
Used the isolated local price control through CLI to decrease NEAR by 2%; browser showed liquidation and pending eligible loss.
Followed the recovery guide to the settled Life and inspected token ID, owner, round, cap and expiry.
Claimed allocated test USDC through browser.
Entered an asking price of 10 test USDC and listed through browser.
Selected bot1.test.near through Demo account menu, inspected marketplace and bought through browser.
Opened the same Life, verified bot1 ownership and claimed as buyer through browser.
Switched back to demo.test.near and verified no claim or sell controls were available for that Life.

limitations: Browser timing includes tool interaction and inspection time, not a human usability benchmark.
Manual Demo celebration previews were checked only in the final presentation smoke and are not evidence of earnings.
NFT lifetime totals do not provide reliably attributed per-NFT historical transactions.
Local mocks and test balances do not validate real demand or external integrations.
This records prior revisions and does not verify later wallet or economics changes. A scripted test-USDC sale is not evidence of independent buyer demand.
